parameter: EIA 5.1 Traffic: heavy vehicles avoid the village road 07:30-09:00 and 16:00-18:00
remarks: ALP-EPC-00000-ME-RPT-0001 (abnormal load route survey and transport drawings); ALP-EPC-00000-HS-PLN-0003; permit PMT-009.
value_text: The abnormal load transport and delivery scheduling excludes these periods on the village road; heavy transport uses the route defined in the route survey, and the abnormal load permits are applied for with these restrictions (PMT-009). The construction traffic management is part of the CESMP.
